```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(cd2030.core)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(flextable)
library(reactable)
library(officedown)
library(officer)

cache <- params$cache
adminlevel_1 <- params$adminlevel_1
last_year <- robust_max(cache$data_years)

# --- INITIALIZE POSTER LAYOUT (Landscape 22 x 17) ---
layout <- cd_multicol_factory(
  width = 22.0, 
  height = 17.0, 
  orient = "landscape", 
  margins = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
)

my_multicol_start <- layout$start
my_multicol_stop <- layout$stop
```

```{r, fig.width=21.0}
# 1. Extract Population Data
cov <- cache$indicator_coverage_district %>% 
  filter(adminlevel_1 == !!adminlevel_1, year == last_year) 

pop_cov <- cov %>% select(district, totunder1_dhis2)

pop_data <- cache$countdown_data %>%
  filter(adminlevel_1 == !!adminlevel_1, year == last_year) %>%
  distinct(district, total_pop, live_births) %>%
  left_join(pop_cov, by = "district") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x)))

# 2. Extract Coverage Data
anc1_cov <- paste0('cov_anc1_', cache$get_denominator('anc1'))
births_cov <- paste0('cov_instlivebirths_', cache$get_denominator('instlivebirths'))
penta1_cov <- paste0('cov_penta1_', cache$get_denominator('penta1'))
penta3_cov <- paste0('cov_penta3_', cache$get_denominator('penta3'))
mcv1_cov <- paste0('cov_measles1_', cache$get_denominator('measles1'))
mcv3_cov <- paste0('cov_measles3_', cache$get_denominator('measles3'))

cov_data <- cov %>% 
  select(district, any_of(c(anc1_cov, births_cov, penta1_cov, penta3_cov, mcv1_cov, mcv3_cov))) %>% 
  mutate(across(-district, ~ round(.x, digits = 1)))

# 3. Merge both into a single Master Table
master_table <- left_join(pop_data, cov_data, by = "district") %>%
  arrange(district)

# 4. Calculate proper totals and averages across all columns
totals <- master_table %>%
  summarise(
    total_pop = sum(total_pop, na.rm = TRUE),
    live_births = sum(live_births, na.rm = TRUE),
    totunder1_dhis2 = sum(totunder1_dhis2, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(any_of(c(anc1_cov, births_cov, penta1_cov, penta3_cov, mcv1_cov, mcv3_cov)), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, digits = 1)),
    district = !!adminlevel_1
  )

# 5. Render the combined table spanning the full width
bind_rows(totals, master_table) %>%
  relocate(district) %>% 
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(
    values = list2(
      district = "District",
      total_pop = "Population",
      live_births = "Live Births",
      totunder1_dhis2 = 'Under 1',
      !!anc1_cov := "ANC 1",
      !!births_cov := "Inst. Births",
      !!penta1_cov := "Penta 1",
      !!penta3_cov := "Penta 3",
      !!mcv1_cov := "MCV 1",
      !!mcv3_cov := "MCV 3"
    )
  ) %>%
  fontsize(part = 'body', size = 11) %>%
  bold(part = "header", bold = TRUE) %>%
  fontsize(part = 'header', size = 11) %>%
  bold(i = 1, part = "body") %>% 
  bg(i = 1, part = "body", bg = "grey90") %>% 
  autofit() %>%
  # Forces the table to expand to exactly 100% of the available horizontal space
  set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
```
